name: Wake Up & Check Inventory
description: Wake up, eat food, check inventory, greet nearby players

name: Harvest & Replant Farm
description: Check farm within 100 blocks: harvest crops, replant seeds, collect drops

name: Hunt Animals / Guard Farm
description: Hunt passive mobs for meat or defend farm

name: Collect Wood Logs
description: Chop trees for up to 16 wood logs, replant saplings

name: Mine Stone, Coal & Iron
description: Mine stone, coal and iron above y=40, avoid lava

name: Craft Tools & Smelt Ores
description: Craft tools/torches/bread, smelt ores, repair gear

name: Deposit Excess Items
description: Store excess items in chest, keep essential tools/food/seeds

name: Visit Players & Ask for Seeds/Wood
description: Visit nearby players, greet them, offer help or ask for seeds/wood if needed

name: Return Home & Light Base
description: Head back home, place torches around base before nightfall

name: Sleep in Bed
description: Find bed and sleep through the night. Stand safe if no bed available.
